card.name: Just before a scientist's surname
card.fires_on: Words right before an author's or researcher's surname in science text, such as the joiner or initial in a reference list or the title or first name before a name. The next word is a surname.

modes.label: Reference list joiners
modes.description: An ampersand, 'and', comma or initial's period between authors in a citation, just before the next surname.
